title: Tiny, cute red car
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#6a1030'/>
  <!-- car body -->
  <rect x='14' y='48' width='72' height='22' rx='8' fill='#e8302f'/>
  <!-- body highlight top -->
  <rect x='18' y='50' width='64' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff6b5e'/>
  <!-- cabin roof -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q34 32 50 32 Q66 32 70 48 Z' fill='#c41f24'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <path d='M35 46 Q37.5 36 49 36 L49 46 Z' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <path d='M53 36 Q64 36 66.5 46 L53 46 Z' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <path d='M39 40 L42 40 L41 44 L38 44 Z' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='56' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- taillight -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='56' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#ff2d6f'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='9' fill='#3a2050'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='4' fill='#c9b3e6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='70' r='9' fill='#3a2050'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='70' r='4' fill='#c9b3e6'/>
  <!-- smile bumper -->
  <path d='M40 64 Q50 70 60 64' stroke='#ffb3a8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
